description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


Adjustable UI font size and a clear error message when WebView2 is broken
- Added a UI font size setting so the whole interface can be scaled to your preference
- On Windows, if the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing or broken, the app now shows a clear error dialog with a button to open the official repair download page, instead of silently flashing a window and exiting
